arguments.content: Pattern: receipt-schema upgrades can hide default-path regressions in independently deployed clients. In enhanced-settings task 1, the test mock was changed to a future receipt response while the client unconditionally required applied=True. The released provider persisted the write and returned only ok=True, so the default client path reported failure despite successful application. Existing tests passed. For this pattern, validate the client against actual released-provider source, checking both persisted state and caller-visible success; a mock updated to the candidate protocol does not establish release compatibility. Preserve legacy behavior until receipt use is explicitly enabled or capability-negotiated. Independent reviewer severity P1; parent reproduced against eval-release.
